added.name: Operon
added.long_description:
Operon is the data intelligence layer for heavy industry. We ingest the messy documents a plant runs on (P&IDs, schematics, datasheets, scans) and turn them into one structured, queryable model of the facility.

On top of it, engineers query their plant in natural language and build agentic workflows for safety, compliance, and design.
added.one_liner: Agentic data layer for manufacturing & process industries.

added.name: Ploid
added.long_description:
Ploid is the AI-native people data infrastructure for building products, workflows, and agents around people. We’ve built an index of 2B+ people across professional and social sources, with the infrastructure to search, resolve, enrich, and retrieve up-to-date information about anyone on demand.

Through Ploid’s API, CLI, and MCP, developers and companies can search for people, enrich profiles, find emails and phone numbers, resolve identities across different data points, and access the broader web context associated with a person. Unlike traditional people databases that rely primarily on static records, Ploid is designed for AI-native workflows. We combine our people index with real-time retrieval and entity resolution so data can be refreshed and expanded at the moment it is requested.

Ploid can power everything from sales and recruiting products to customer intelligence, identity resolution, trust and safety, and AI agents that need reliable information about people. Instead of building and maintaining dozens of data integrations yourself, Ploid gives you one infrastructure layer for people data.

2B+ people. One API. Built for AI.
added.one_liner: The people data company for the agent era

added.name: Latent
added.long_description: Latent catches wrong or unsupported LLM answers before they reach your users. Instead of running a second model to check every output, it reads the model's own internal state as it generates, so every request is verified with no added latency, no extra inference cost, and nothing leaving your deployment. Teams running LLMs in production, in finance, legal, healthcare and customer support, get a review queue of the answers most likely to be wrong, calibrated to their own model and traffic, with a plain explanation of why each one was flagged.
added.one_liner: Catch wrong LLM answers before your customers do

added.name: Keres
added.long_description: Keres builds reusable unmanned jet interceptors for air defense. The Garmur launches on cue, closes at jet speed, positively identifies and kills drones and cruise missiles, then lands to fly again. It gives commanders a fighter-class response at a fraction of the cost.
added.one_liner: Kill the drone, keep the jet. Reusable unmanned interceptors.

removed.name: Vendo
removed.long_description:
Vendo is the customization layer that lets your users build their own features and micro-apps directly on top of your product. Rather than waiting on an ever-growing feature backlog, your users can personalize the product to exactly how they work, create their own automations, and integrate hundreds of external tools, all without your team writing a line of code.

Everything runs on your existing API, renders natively in your own theme and components, and executes inside secure sandboxes within your existing security guardrails, so your source code is never touched. Companies can plug Vendo into an agent they already have, or deploy a production-ready agent complete with the ability to take actions in the product, generate UI, and draw on a built-in knowledge base. Vendo is open source and installs with a single command, and we work closely with teams to get it running for their product.
removed.one_liner: Let your users build their own features on top of your product

long_description.before: We have developed an AI platform enabling to accelerate the discovery and the design of genomic therapies such as Cell Therapies, RNA Therapies and DNA Therapies.
long_description.after:
WhiteLab Genomics is a TechBio company using artificial intelligence to design the building blocks of genomic medicines. Its proprietary ALFRED platform designs viral and non-viral delivery vehicles and programmable genetic payloads, which are then experimentally validated and tested in vivo to identify candidates with the properties required for therapeutic development. 

Through this integrated approach, WhiteLab Genomics is building a portfolio of validated bio-assets that it advances independently and with pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners developing the next generation of genomic medicines.

Founded in 2019, WhiteLab works with industrial and academic partners including Sanofi, Cytiva, the University of Massachusetts, the Vision Institute in Paris and the Paris Brain Institute, alongside additional collaborations with biotechnology companies. The company is part of Y-Combinator, Station F and Future4Care and is a French Tech 2030 laureate.

WhiteLab Genomics operates from Paris, Boston, and Montreal.

one_liner.before: Unleashing the potential of DNA and RNA based therapies using AI
one_liner.after: Unleash the potential of genomic medicine using AI

long_description.before:
The pandemic reduced office use nationwide by 50%, and tenants have been left to deal with highly inflexible, long term lease agreements that don’t fit today’s office use patterns.

The traditional brokerage model works great for big spaces and long terms. But when you want to talk smaller units, short term lengths, shared and common areas, you’re out of luck. 

Tandem is an AI-native office leasing platform. We’re using technology to unlock an easier leasing process.   Our AI co-pilot provides a white-glove-quality B2B office search experience, with a fraction of the human labor typically required.

Today we’re serving three primary markets — NY, SF and BOS.  We’ve helped more than 500 companies find great office space and have seen double-digit month-over-month growth.

long_description.before:
Captain syncs complex, multimodal files and cloud storage from sources like S3, SharePoint, and Google Drive, and makes that knowledge searchable for your agents.

Instead of stitching together parsers, embeddings, vector databases, rerankers, and retrieval infrastructure, Captain self-tunes the retrieval pipeline to your data and workloads.

On benchmarks, this improves accuracy from roughly 78% with standard RAG to over 97% by tuning retrieval to the unique structure and content of your data.

Captain is purpose-built for complex, regulated, and high-stakes file search workloads.

Learn more at https://captain.dev
long_description.after:
Captain makes product catalogs and complex, multimodal files searchable for customers and AI agents. It syncs files from sources like S3, SharePoint, and Google Drive and tunes search to your data and workloads.

Instead of stitching together parsers, embeddings, vector databases, rerankers, and retrieval infrastructure, developers use Captain to power product search and file retrieval through managed APIs.

On evaluated file-search benchmarks, Captain’s tuning improved retrieval accuracy from roughly 78% with standard RAG to over 97%.

Built for complex catalogs and demanding file-search workloads, including regulated and high-stakes applications.

one_liner.before: Self-tuning file search for AI agents
one_liner.after: Self-tuning search for products and files

long_description.before: TakeCareOS is building the infrastructure for the AI-native long term care providers. Today’s care providers are held back by massive administrative overhead, buried under fragmented tools and manual workflows. TakeCareOS consolidates the entire care lifecycle—scheduling, billing, documentation, compliance, customer support etc.—into a single, intelligent system driven by AI agents. We are eliminating the operational friction of care coordination to establish a new standard of high-efficiency, highly scalable care practices.
long_description.after:
Teaflask is the AI layer for software companies. It lets any SaaS company put an agent inside its product that carries out tasks for its users, with the controls enterprises require. Customers go live in a day, without a rebuild.

Calling a model is the easy part of shipping an in-product agent. The hard part is everything around it: streaming, crash recovery, scaling, guardrails, interfaces that match the product, and knowledge that stays current as the code changes. Teaflask handles all of it with no backend changes, and gives product teams visibility into how their users actually use the product.

one_liner.before: AI-native operating system for long term care providers
one_liner.after: Make your product AI native by tomorrow.

long_description.before:
Corvera (YC W26) is the AI sales engine for CPG brands. We turn the data a brand already has into the actions its sales team takes today.

A CPG brand sells into tens of thousands of independent US stores through dozens of distributors, and works that base with a handful of people. CLEAN Cause, a $20M yerba mate brand, covers 21,000 stores through 46 distributors with a four-person sales team. The accounts worth a call are not capped by headcount. The team is.

CLEAN Cause now runs its daily sales decisions on Corvera: 5,000 queries in 40 days across 12 users, $250K of opportunities surfaced within days, and a 7x return on the analysts they would otherwise hire.

With Corvera in place, every sales rep starts the morning with:
- The stores to act on today, ranked and priced, with the reason on the row,
- The outreach already drafted to the right contact at the right distributor, and
- The follow-up booked, logged, and measured against the goal it was set to move.

All from the distributor feeds, retailer portals, and ERP data they already have, resolved into one context layer - without a data team, and without handing their sales to a broker.

We’re founded by Chris (2x Founder; ex-CEO at Better Nature; Forbes 30U30), Dirk (ex-Google Data & AI Lead), and Matthew (ex-Head of Product at Rosemark; Princeton MEng in CS).

To date, we’ve raised $6.2M and are backed by YC, firstminute capital, 6 Degrees Capital, 20VC, Rebel Fund, Duke Capital Partners, and more. Our ICP is US CPG brands doing $20M+ in retail revenue through UNFI, KeHE and DSD distributors. We sell to VPs of Sales and CEOs.

The incumbents prove the scale. Brokers take 5-12% of a $350B US independent grocery market, and Advantage Solutions, a publicly traded company, does $3.5B in annual revenue.

Our mission is bold: to enable the next generation of unicorn CPG brands to be run by teams of less than 10 people.

Our vision is even bolder: to give every CPG brand the coverage of a full sales team at a fraction of the headcount, and displace the broker network that covers the US independent channel today.

Visit www.corvera.ai to learn more!

long_description.before:
Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself, from clinical notes and treatment plans to insurance claims and finding new clients.

Therapists hold the world together. They also run businesses, file insurance claims, write letters, fill forms, supervise new grads, and do hours of paperwork every night. 

Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it.

Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients.

Nearly 8,300 therapists use Klarify today.

Our mission is to empower therapists, not replace them. So they can focus on the one thing only a human can do. Be present with their client.

long_description.before:
Intelligence will be the most valuable asset a company owns. Today, almost every company rents it.

Companies pay a handful of labs one token at a time. Each dollar buys an answer, not an asset. They spend more, but own nothing more.

Riften reverses that.

Change one environment variable and Riften becomes the gateway for a company's AI traffic. We route each request to the lowest-cost model that can do the job, serving most work on open-weight models we host. Customers save money immediately without rebuilding their products.

The gateway is the entry point. Over time, Riften turns the company's work into private models built on open weights and shaped around the business. What begins as cheaper inference becomes an intelligence stack the company owns, runs on infrastructure it controls, and uses to power its most important applications.

We call this earned intelligence. It is created by the company's own work, controlled by the company, and accumulated over time.

The next generation of companies will not rent their intelligence. They will earn it, own it, and compound it. Riften is how they get there.
long_description.after:
Riften builds model routing, evaluations, private models, and training environments for AI labs, AI-native companies, and enterprises.

We help teams choose models for their workloads, evaluate how they perform, and build private models around company-specific work. We’re also developing coding environments where agents learn through backend engineering tasks.

long_description.before: Hubble is the AI-native retrieval engine for medical records, delivered in one API. I scaled Grow Therapy to a $3B valuation; my cofounder built One Medical's first AI agents, now used by millions of patients. Four weeks in, we already have ten signed customers and 7-figure year-one revenue across platform and usage fees. Every new agentic use case across industries like legal, clinical trials, consumer health, insurance, needs a complete medical record, and today that still means faxes and phone calls. Hubble fixes that with voice and browser agents that reach the providers APIs can't, in a market worth $45B just in the verticals we've mapped so far.
long_description.after:
Hubble’s mission is to unify the patient medical record and remove the barriers to accessing it. Today, a person’s health history is scattered across disconnected systems, leaving patients and the people helping them to piece it together. We’re building a future where one authorization unlocks a more complete record, regardless of where someone received care.

Our founders previously built healthcare and AI products at Grow Therapy and Amazon One Medical, and we’re backed by Y Combinator, Madrona, and Basis Set. We’re building our team in Seattle, with the opportunity to work directly with the founders and shape how people access and use their health information.

long_description.before:
TrueMile is an AI operations team for midsize trucking carriers. Our agents work together to source freight, plan the week, assign loads to drivers, and keep customers, drivers, and dispatchers informed.

When a driver calls out, a truck gets delayed, or a load cancels, TrueMile coordinates the assignments, plan changes, and communications that follow. It connects to the systems carriers already use, with dispatchers in control.
long_description.after:
TrueMile is building a fully autonomous logistics company, starting with trucking. Delayed pickups, empty miles and poor planning eat into a carrier’s profits. Our agents coordinate loads, routes, driver schedules and fuel stops to earn more from each truck and lower the cost of moving goods.

We’re starting with our own fleet so we control execution, learn from every delivery and keep the gains. Human drivers come first. As autonomous trucks become available on our routes, we’ll have the customers, freight and infrastructure ready for them.

As we drive toward AGI, people will still need groceries, clothes and materials to build their homes. Someone has to move all of it. We want every leap in AI to show up in what people pay for everyday goods.

one_liner.before: AI agents that run trucking operations.

long_description.before:
We design and manufacture high-mix drone motors and robotic actuators in LA.

DJI, Apple, and Ford don't settle for OTS components. Likewise, the teams that win the Western robotics market will build seamless machines from tightly integrated software and hardware. 

Pendulum Robotics designs motors and actuators around your robot's unique form factor and mission - then we rapidly bring them to life with proprietary software and tooling geared for high-mix machining and assembly. We've designed and built motors for top drone OEMs and can assemble thousands of motors per month at our first factory in LA.

We're doing for motion components what 3D printing has done for structural components. This enables hardware teams to build and iterate at the speed of software so they can create elegant, reliable, ROI-positive robots and win massive markets.
